message:
I am thinking...: No network access for apt. I can't install ruby/bison. So I can't easily build mruby via rake. 

But I could potentially build a minimal version manually with gcc, since mruby's build is essentially compiling C files. The parser (parse.y) needs bison/yacc to generate parse.c. Let me check if parse.c is pre-generated in the source tree (sometimes it is committed).

Let me check if there's a pre-generated parse.c. If so, I can compile mruby manually with gcc + ASAN and test my PoC.

Actually, let me check the mrblib too — mruby compiles ruby stdlib into C. But for a minimal test, I might be able to build just the core.

Let me look at what's needed. The fuzzer harness mruby_fuzzer.c needs mrb_open and mrb_load_string. mrb_open requires the whole mruby core compiled and the mrblib (Ruby stdlib) compiled in.

This is getting complex. Let me check if parse.c is pre-generated.
